---

{{ if and (ne .Vars.win22cis_system_role "domaincontroller") .Vars.win22cis_level_1 }}
  {{ if .Vars.win22cis_rule_2_3_7_8 }}
    {{ if eq .Vars.win22cis_system_role "memberserver" }}
registry:
  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon\ForceUnlockLogon:
    title: "2.3.7.8 | Ensure 'Interactive logon: Require Domain Controller Authentication to unlock workstation' is set to 'Enabled' (MS only) | ForceUnlockLogon"
    exists: true
    value: 1
    type: REG_DWORD
    meta:
      memberserver: 1
      server: 1
      CIS_ID:
        - 2.3.7.8
      NIST800-53R5:
        - AC-2(5)
        - AC-11
        - AC-11(1)
        - AC-12
    {{ end }}
  {{ end }}
{{ end }}

steps.shell:
- name: "2.3.7.8 | PATCH | Ensure Interactive logon Require Domain Controller Authentication to unlock workstation is set to Enabled MS only | Member Server"
  when:
    - win22cis_rule_2_3_7_8
    - prelim_win22cis_is_domain_member
  tags:
    - level1-memberserver
    - rule_2.3.7.8
    - patch
    - logon
    - NIST800-171_3.1.1
    - NIST800-171_3.1.10
    - NIST800-171_3.1.11
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-2_5
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-11
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-11_1
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-12
  ansible.windows.win_regedit:
    path: HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows Nt\CurrentVersion\Winlogon
    name: ForceUnlockLogon
    data: 1
    type: dword
